description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants hosted former SMU safety Ahmaad Moses for a workout on Monday.
items.impact: Moses underwent spinal fusion surgery after learning of a herniated disc during an MRI at the combine. He was recently cleared.
items.title: Ahmaad Moses to workout for Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants hosted Tony Grimes for a workout.
items.impact: Grimes was previously at the Titans and Panthers rookie minicamps.
items.title: Tony Grimes to workout for Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers are working out Lenny Krieg.
items.impact: Krieg was 14 of 14 on field goals at the NFL scouting combine last year and was on the Falcons practice squad. He made a 57-yard field goal during the preseason last year.
items.title: Lenny Krieg to workout for Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Andrew Farmer II is missing practice on Monday due to a back issue.
items.impact: Farmer will miss some time to begin training camp.
items.title: Andrew Farmer II (back) not practicing Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Kirk did not practice on Monday due to a calf injury.
items.impact: Kirk walked off the practice field on Sunday with the injury. It is unclear how serious it is.
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Gracen Halton is not practicing on Monday due to a knee bone bruise.
items.impact: Halton is expected to miss some time to begin training camp.
items.title: Gracen Halton (knee) not practicing Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vederian Lowe is not practicing on Monday due to a high ankle sprain.
items.impact: Lowe is likely to miss some time with his injury.
items.title: Vederian Lowe (ankle) not practicing Monday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Miles Sanders worked out for the Las Vegas Raiders on Monday.
items.impact: Sanders is coming off a year with the Cowboys in which he suffered a season-ending knee injury in December. The running back has not rushed for 500 yards since 2022, but could be a good veteran backup to Ashton Jeanty in a light running back room.
items.title: Miles Sanders works out with Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers beat reporter Greg Auman said there has been no word on a potential Baker Mayfield contract discussion ahead of training camp.
items.impact: Mayfield has been seeking a new contract this offseason. It is unclear when his self-imposed deadline would be that he reportedly set. There is less than 24 hours until veterans report for training camp.
items.title: Baker Mayfield: No update on new contract

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Jacoby Brissett will work with the starters starting on Tuesday.
items.impact: Brissett returned to practice on Sunday after landing his new deal. The Cardinals are in pads for the first time on Tuesday.
items.title: Jacoby Brissett to work with starters in practice Tuesday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Daniel Jones is fully cleared from his torn Achilles and will be a "full go" to begin training camp.
items.impact: The Colts will begin their training camp on Tuesday, and Jones will be on the field participating in 11-on-11 play on day one. The quarterback suffered a torn Achilles last December and now looks to be on track to be ready to go for Week 1 of this upcoming season, barring any setbacks. Jones is still someone to monitor as the calendar turns to August.
items.title: Daniel Jones (Achilles) fully cleared heading into training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Devin Culp is expected to be good to go for the start of training camp.
items.impact: Culp was held out of minicamp with an undisclosed injury. He will be competing for a depth role in the Buccaneers tight end room.
items.title: Devin Culp (undisclosed) expected to be good to go for training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lan Larison appears to be the early favorite to be the RB3 in the Patriots backfield.
items.impact: The same report was also made earlier in the Patriots offseason program. Daniels notes that Larison got a lot of reps on Monday with Drake Maye's unit. Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson should still continue to dominate the snaps.
items.title: Lan Larison remains early favorite to be Patriots' RB3

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: LB Troy Reeder agreed to terms with the Lions.
items.impact: Reeder spent the last three seasons with the Rams. He'll add depth in the linebacker from for Detroit.
items.title: Troy Reeder signs with Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: A.J. Brown told reporters Monday he is at 90 percent on learning the Patriots offense.
items.impact: Brown being moved was one of the top storylines of the offseason. He is using this time to build a rapport with Drake Maye as he gets adjusted to a new offense and system. Brown is currently going off the board as the WR12 per FantasyPros ADP.
items.title: A.J. Brown says he is at 90 percent on learning Patriots offense

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Eli Raridon will have an opportunity to "make an impact" during his rookie season behind veteran Hunter Henry thanks both to his skillset and the lack of depth at the position behind him.
items.impact: Raridon will be behind Henry at least to start the season, but he could find himself a role down the stretch should the veteran suffer an injury. Henry is on the wrong side of 30, so the team is needing a young and promising talent to come in. Hopefully Raridon is the next productive Patriots tight end. The rookie's own injury history is concerning, however, and much remains undecided.
items.title: Eli Raridon has the opportunity to 'make an impact' in 2026

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jordan James began the 49ers training camp as the RB2 behind Christian McCaffrey, with Kaelon Black and Patrick Taylor taking snaps after.
items.impact: It's still early in the process, so the veteran James getting work over a third round rookie in Black makes sense. If this continues to be a trend, however, James could be a priority handcuff for McCaffrey in 2026, and if nothing else he's a name to watch.
items.title: Jordan James begins camp as Niners RB2

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots placed Jeremiah Webb on injured reserve.
items.impact: Webb is out for the season.
items.title: Jeremiah Webb placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots placed Gabe Jacas on the PUP list.
items.impact: Jacas recently signed his rookie contract with New England. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Gabe Jacas placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions placed TE Tyler Conklin on the PUP list.
items.impact: Conklin isn't ready to go to begin training camp. He can be activated at any time through late August.
items.title: Tyler Conklin placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions placed S Brian Branch on the PUP list.
items.impact: Branch is continuing to work his way back from a torn Achilles. His timetable to return remains uncertain.
items.title: Brian Branch (Achilles) placed on PUP list

items.title: Al'zillion Hamilton placed on PUP list
